reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but writes its own daily-skip versus move decision instead of extracting the one getUpcomingDates and getNextDate already apply.

duplication.why: The per-occurrence weekend resolution (skipWeekend && daily -> drop weekend, else move) is a third copy of logic already in getUpcomingDates and getNextDate.

placement.why: A handler in server/schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates is where the tree registers such handlers; the occurrence-resolution logic would belong in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests are added.

maintainability.why: The handler is readable, but the weekend rule now lives in three hand-written places that must be changed together when it changes again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared occurrence-resolution helper exists in the tree to go around; getDateWithSkippedWeekend is used.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts restates getUpcomingDates' isDaily/skipWeekend branch reshaped as an early 'continue' plus reassignment, rather than sharing it.
